description: Chezmoi managed dotfiles!

name: achievements
description: Unlocks eight badges once each (first session, first green test run, 100 and 1,000 tool calls, 7-day streak, 10 blocked calls, a 2 hour session, night owl), with a toast and /achievements.

name: agent-firewall
description: A live pane of every tool call the agent makes: green when it ran, red when it was blocked, with counters. Open it with /firewall.

name: ahead-behind
description: A band above the prompt with the commits ahead and behind the upstream (↑2 ↓1), read with git status after each Bash call and file edit. Hidden when the branch has no upstream.

name: audit-pack
description: Three read-only audit commands in one mod: /secret-scan, /conflicts and /licenses. They read git, project files and dependency folders. They copy results to the clipboard.

name: authors
description: Adds /authors: the top 15 contributors by commit count with their last commit date, from git log. Names only, never email addresses. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: auto-format
description: Runs your project's own formatter on each file Claude writes or edits, only when the project has a formatter config, and tells Claude to re-read the file.

name: auto-lint
description: Runs your project's own linter fix (eslint, ruff or golangci-lint) on each file Claude writes or edits, only when the project has that linter's config, and tells Claude what is left.

name: band-pack
description: The first six Baselane band meters in one row above the prompt: session cost, lattes, context bar, today's spend, the focus timer and the mood ring.

name: battery-band
description: A band above the prompt with the Mac battery percent and charging state (🔋 87%, ⚡ 54% while charging), read from pmset once a minute. Hidden on other systems.

name: bead
description: Adds /bead <id>: one bead with status, priority, labels, description, blockers and children. Read with bd, the beads tracker. Read-only. Prints only, copies nothing.

name: bead-chime
description: Plays a short chime when a Bash call that ran bd close (or bd done) ends with exit code 0. It reads only the command text and the result, and runs no program.

name: bead-claim-nudge
description: At turn end, if Claude edited a file and no bead is in progress, shows a toast and reminds Claude at your next prompt, once per session. Reads with bd count; quiet without bd.

name: bead-commit-nudge
description: At turn end, if a git commit named no bead id while a bead is in progress, shows a toast and reminds Claude at your next prompt. Reads with bd count and bd where; quiet without bd.

name: bead-now
description: A band above the prompt with the bead in progress you updated last and how many more are in progress, read with bd list every 2 minutes and after Claude runs bd. Hidden when none is.

name: bead-stale-nudge
description: At session start, one toast when beads in progress have had no update for 7 days, with their ids. Reads with bd stale, and says nothing without bd or a beads project.

name: bead-streak
description: Counts the days in a row you closed a bead, from Bash calls that ran bd close and exited 0. Adds /bead-streak and a toast on a new best. Reads command text only, runs no program.

name: beads-band
description: A band above the prompt with your beads counts (bd 97 ready · 45 active · 29 blocked), read with bd status every 2 minutes and after Claude runs bd. Hidden without bd or a beads project.

name: beads-bars
description: All six beads bands in one row: counts, the bead in progress, epic progress, done percent, closed today and open by priority, read with bd every 2 minutes and after Claude runs bd.

name: beads-done-bar
description: A band above the prompt with how much of your beads project is closed, as a bar and a percent (beads █████████░ 88%), read with bd status every 2 minutes. Hidden without bd.

name: beads-guard
description: Asks before bd commands that delete data or rewrite history: delete, purge, prune, gc, sql, admin, import, rename, forget, restore, migrate and more. Reads only the command text, runs no bd.

name: beads-pane
description: A live side pane of your beads: in progress, ready and blocked issues, 10 each, with counts. Read with bd, read-only, after Bash calls. Open it with /beads.

name: beads-prime
description: Runs bd prime once per session and adds its text (max 8 KB) to the system prompt, from the repo's .beads files and bd memories. bd setup claude hooks may add it twice.

name: beads-standup
description: Adds /beads-standup: beads closed since yesterday, in progress, and the next 5 ready. Read with bd, the beads tracker. Read-only. Prints only, copies nothing.

name: beads-today-bar
description: A band above the prompt with the beads closed today against a daily goal you set (today ▮▮▮▯▯ 3/5), green when met, read with bd count. Hidden without bd or a beads project.

name: big-diff-nudge
description: Suggests splitting the change once your edits added or removed more than 500 lines since the last git commit. A successful commit resets the count.

name: big-file-guard
description: Asks before a Write creates content over 1 MB, or git add names a file over 5 MB. Measures the files with find.

name: branch-band
description: A band above the prompt with the git branch and the count of changed files, read with git status after each Bash call and file edit.

name: branches
description: Adds /branches: local branches merged into the default branch or idle for 30 days, as a cleanup list, read with git. Never deletes. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: break-nudge
description: Suggests a short break once the session has run 90 minutes, and again every 90 minutes after that.

name: british-english
description: British spelling and terms in prose (colour, organise, licence as a noun). Code identifiers stay as they are.

name: bullet-mode
description: Replies as short bullet lists, at most one sentence per bullet, unless you ask for code.

name: cache-meter
description: A band above the prompt with the share of prompt tokens the cache served this session (cache 87%). A high share means cheaper, faster turns.

name: caveman-mode
description: Prose in short caveman speech ("Fix bug. Test pass."), still accurate. Code and commands stay exact.

name: changelog
description: Adds /changelog: commits since the last tag (or the last 30), read with git log and grouped by conventional-commit type, as Markdown. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: chmod-guard
description: Asks before chmod makes files world-writable (777, a+w, o+w) or chmod or chown runs recursively on a broad path (/, a system folder, a home folder).

name: ci-band
description: A band above the prompt with the latest GitHub Actions run of your branch (ci passed, ci failed, ci running), asked of the gh CLI every 2 minutes; branch read with git. Hidden without gh.

name: ci-config-guard
description: Asks before Write or Edit changes CI config: .github/workflows, .gitlab-ci.yml or .circleci/config.yml.

name: clippy
description: One helpful toast per session per trigger, in the classic paperclip voice: when you edit a migrations folder, a Dockerfile or a GitHub workflow, or run rm -rf. At most one toast per turn.

name: code-only
description: Replies with the code or command first and at most two short sentences of prose, unless asked to explain.

name: command-pack
description: The five original slash commands in one mod: /receipt, /standup, /changelog, /pr-description and /handoff. They read git; /handoff also writes .claude/handoff.md. They copy results to the clipboard.

name: commit-msg
description: Adds /commit-msg: a Conventional Commits message proposed from the staged diff, read with git. Heuristic, no model call, writes nothing. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: commit-nudge
description: Suggests a commit at turn end after 8 or more file edits since the last git commit. One toast per batch of edits; a successful git commit resets the count.

name: conflicts
description: Adds /conflicts: tracked files that still hold merge conflict markers, with line numbers, found with git grep. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: context-meter
description: A band above the prompt with a 10 cell bar of the context window used, yellow from 60 percent, red from 80.

name: context-pane
description: A live side pane of how full the context window is: the percent as a bar, the tokens used, and a short tip past 75 percent. Open it with /context-pane.

name: conventional-commits
description: Commit messages follow Conventional Commits: type(scope): subject, imperative, under 72 characters.

name: cost-meter
description: A band above the prompt with the session cost so far and what the last turn cost.

name: cost-pane
description: A live side pane with the session cost, the cost of each of the last 10 turns as a bar, and the average per turn. Open it with /cost-pane.

name: creator-band
description: The creator band in one row above the prompt: turn timer, count of TODO, FIXME and HACK lines (read with git), and the daily streak flame.

name: cron-guard
description: Asks before scheduled jobs or services are wiped or stopped: crontab -r, crontab replaced from stdin or a file, launchctl unload or bootout, systemctl stop, disable or mask.

name: ctx-nudge
description: Reminds you to /clear or /compact when the context window passes 75 percent.

name: curl-pipe-guard
description: Asks before a download is piped into a shell or interpreter (curl | sh, wget -O- | bash, bash <(curl ...)).

name: daily-spend
description: A band above the prompt with today's total cost across all your sessions.

name: db-reset-guard
description: Asks before a framework wipes a database: prisma migrate reset, rails or rake db:drop and db:reset, alembic downgrade, django flush, supabase db reset, knex rollback --all.

name: debug-print-nudge
description: At turn end, one toast naming the count of console.log, print(, debugger and dbg! lines your edits added this turn. Only code files count.

name: deploy-guard
description: Asks before a production deploy: vercel --prod, netlify deploy --prod, firebase deploy, fly deploy, gcloud app deploy, eb deploy, heroku rollback, serverless deploy to prod.

name: deps
description: Adds /deps: direct dependencies with versions from package.json, pyproject.toml, requirements.txt, go.mod and Cargo.toml at the repo root. No network. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: desktop-notify
description: Shows a desktop notification when Claude Code needs your input: osascript on macOS, notify-send elsewhere when it is installed. The text is the project name and a short status only.

name: dev-band
description: The developer band in one row above the prompt: git branch and changed files (read with git status), wall clock and session age, tool counts, and failed tool calls.

name: diff-stats
description: Edit and Write rows show a compact +12 -3 bar beside the file name: green for lines added, red for lines removed, up to 20 cells.

name: discord-notify
description: Posts to a Discord webhook when Claude Code needs your input. Sends the project name and a short status only. Does nothing until you set a webhook URL.

name: docker-guard
description: Asks before Docker commands that delete data: system, volume or image prune, rm -f, volume rm and compose down -v.

name: docs-nudge
description: At turn end, one toast when edits added exported code (an export statement in .ts or .js, or a public function signature) and no README or docs file was edited this session.

name: docstring-mode
description: Every new or changed public function gets a short doc comment in the language's normal style.

name: eli5-mode
description: Explains like the reader is new: analogies first, no jargon without a one-line definition.

name: env-check
description: Adds /env-check: variable names in .env.example against .env at the git repo root, listing missing and extra names. Reads names only, never a value. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: env-example-nudge
description: At turn end, one toast when edits add a reference to an environment variable (process.env, os.environ, os.getenv, Deno.env) that .env.example does not list. Reads only .env.example names, never .env.

name: env-exfil-guard
description: Asks before a command prints your environment, echoes a secret variable or sends local data to a remote host.

name: envinfo
description: Adds /envinfo: versions of git, node, npm, python3, go, rustc and docker if installed, by running each (2 s limit), and the OS. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: epic-bar
description: A band above the prompt with the progress of the epic you work on, or of the open epic nearest to done (bm-ooq ███████░ 7/8), read with bd. Hidden without epics or bd.

name: epics-pane
description: A live side pane of each open beads epic: a bar of closed and total children, and a mark when it is ready to close. Read with bd, read-only. Open it with /epics.

name: error-meter
description: A band above the prompt with how many tool calls failed this session (an error or a deny) and which tool failed last. Red from the first failure.

name: exit-badge
description: A failed Bash row shows a small red badge with its exit code, for example exit 2.

name: explore-pack
description: Five read-only repo exploration commands in one mod: /tree, /deps, /authors, /scripts and /env-check. They read git and project files. They copy results to the clipboard.

name: file-links
description: In Claude's replies, path/to/file.ts:42 references to files in your project become links. Click one to put @path/to/file.ts in the prompt.

name: file-owners
description: Adds /owners <path>: the top 5 authors of a file or folder by lines, from git blame. Names only, never addresses. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: files-pane
description: A live side pane of the files Claude read, edited or wrote this session, grouped by action with a count per file, newest first. Open it with /files.

name: focus-pack
description: Three quiet nudges in one mod: commit after 8 edits, TODO/FIXME/HACK lines added, and debug prints added.

name: fun-pack
description: Fun habits in one install: caveman prose and gitmoji commit messages. They compose: caveman never touches commit messages.

name: git-history-guard
description: Asks before git commands that throw away work or rewrite history: reset --hard, clean, rebase, filter-branch, filter-repo, push --delete, branch -D and stash clear.

name: git-pane
description: A live side pane, read with git: the branch, ahead and behind its upstream, changed files (staged and unstaged) and the last 5 commits. Refreshes after git commands and edits. Open it with /git.

name: gitignore-check
description: Asks before git add or commit when secret-looking files are not ignored or are already tracked. Checks with git ls-files.

name: gitmoji-commits
description: Commit messages start with the matching gitmoji (✨ feat, 🐛 fix). Composes with conventional-commits: emoji goes before the type.

name: guard-devops
description: Asks before harsh DevOps commands: destructive Docker, Kubernetes and Helm calls, CI config edits, broad chmod and chown, and git commands that lose work. Add infra-guard for plain kubectl delete.

name: guard-essentials
description: Asks only before harsh or disaster commands: destructive infra, git and SQL, piping downloads into a shell, sudo, leaking or committing secrets. Reads git. The quiet choice for daily work.

name: guard-pack
description: The 15 core Baselane guards in one mod (secrets, git, infra, packages, path jail). Some read git, measure files with find, read HOME with printenv, or check where a path really lands.

name: haiku-commits
description: Commit messages get a normal conventional-commit first line, then a 5-7-5 haiku about the change in the body.

name: handoff
description: Adds /handoff: writes a session summary with the git status to .claude/handoff.md (never overwriting) and answers with the path. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: heatmap
description: Adds /heatmap: a 12-week calendar grid of the days you used Claude Code, like a contribution graph, shaded by turns, naming your busiest day.

name: hotspots
description: Adds /hotspots: the 10 files changed most often in the last 90 days, from git log, with change counts. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: infra-guard
description: Asks before terraform destroy, kubectl delete, force-push, DROP TABLE or rm -rf.

name: issue-links
description: #123 references in Claude's replies become links to that issue when the repository's origin is on GitHub or GitLab. Display only.

name: json-pretty
description: Bash output that is one long line of JSON is drawn pretty-printed, folded after 30 lines. Display only: Claude reads the output as it was.

name: junior-mode
description: Explains each step and why, and defines jargon once, for a learner.

name: k8s-guard
description: Asks before kubectl apply or replace with --force, kubectl drain, helm uninstall, and kubectl delete behind global flags (plain kubectl delete is infra-guard's).

name: langs
description: Counts the file types Claude edits across sessions and adds /langs: a bar list of the types edited most, each file counted once per session.

name: latte-meter
description: A band above the prompt that counts the session cost in lattes. Set the latte price in the plugin options.

name: licenses
description: Adds /licenses: the licence of each direct dependency, from node_modules and Python dist-info at the git repo root. Shows unknown when it cannot tell. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: lifecycle-pack
description: The four original lifecycle mods in one: runs your formatter, sends ntfy.sh pushes for long commands and input waits, and appends to ~/.claude/journal.log.

name: loc
description: Adds /loc: lines of tracked text files by language, read with git, sorted, with a total. Skips lockfiles and binaries. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: lockfile-guard
description: Asks before a lockfile is written or edited by hand; the package manager should change it.

name: lockfile-nudge
description: At turn end, one toast when dependencies in package.json, pyproject.toml, Cargo.toml or go.mod changed and neither the matching lockfile was edited nor an install command ran.

name: long-run-notify
description: Sends a phone push through ntfy.sh when a Bash command ran longer than a threshold (60 seconds by default). Sends the project name and the seconds only. Does nothing until you set an ntfy topic.

name: mentor-pack
description: Mentor habits in one install: a hint and a guiding question first, assumptions listed before work, and a strict self-review after each change.

name: migration-guard
description: Asks before Write or Edit changes a migration that already exists; new migration files pass.

name: migration-nudge
description: At turn end, one toast when a schema file changed (schema.prisma, models.py, SQL under schema/, a drizzle schema) and no migration file was created this session.

name: model-badge
description: A band above the prompt with the current model name and the context percent (opus-4-1 · 62%).

name: mood-ring
description: A band above the prompt with a colored dot and a word for the error and block rate of your last 20 tool calls: calm (green) under 10 percent, tense (yellow) under 30, stormy (red) from 30.

name: night-owl
description: Records the hour of each prompt across sessions and adds /hours: a 24-hour histogram of when you work, naming your peak hour.

name: no-em-dash
description: Never writes the em-dash character. Uses a comma, colon, period or parentheses.

name: no-sycophancy
description: No flattery or filler. Disagreement is stated plainly, with the reason.

name: no-verify-guard
description: Asks before git hooks are skipped (--no-verify, commit -n, HUSKY=0, core.hooksPath=/dev/null).

name: noir-mode
description: Prose like a hard-boiled detective narrator, light and clear. Code, commands, commit messages and error text stay exact.

name: notify-pack
description: Local alerts in one: a desktop notification when Claude Code needs your input (osascript or notify-send), and a spoken line (say) on macOS when a long turn ends.

name: now-playing
description: A band above the prompt with the track Music or Spotify plays on your Mac (♪ Song - Artist), read with pgrep and osascript once a minute, only from a player that runs. Hidden when nothing plays.

name: ntfy-notify
description: Sends a phone push through ntfy.sh when Claude Code needs your input. The message is generic. Does nothing until you set an ntfy topic.

name: nudge-pack
description: Two turn-end reminders in one mod: test-reminder and ctx-nudge.

name: ops-band
description: The ops band in one row above the prompt: commits ahead and behind the upstream (git), the latest GitHub Actions run of your branch (gh), and the Mac battery (pmset).

name: package-guard
description: Asks before a new dependency is installed (npm, pnpm, yarn, bun, pip, uv, poetry, cargo, go, gem) and names the packages.

name: path-jail
description: Asks before Write, Edit or NotebookEdit changes a file outside the working directory, by real path.

name: path-shorten
description: Tool rows draw long absolute file paths shorter: the project root as ./ and your home folder as ~. Display only; Bash commands are drawn as they ran.

name: personal-bests
description: Tracks your records across sessions (longest session, most tool calls in a session, most files edited in a day, cheapest session over 30 minutes), toasts a new one, and lists them with /bests.

name: pirate-mode
description: Talks like a pirate in prose, never inside code, commands or file contents.

name: plain-english
description: Writes in ASD-STE-100 Simplified Technical English: short sentences, active voice, simple words.

name: pomodoro
description: A band above the prompt with a 25/5 focus timer (focus 18:42, break 03:10). Start and stop it with /pomodoro; a toast marks each switch.

name: port-watch
description: A live side pane of the local TCP ports that listen, with the process name and pid, refreshed every 10 seconds while open. Reads lsof (macOS, most Linux). Open it with /ports.

name: pr-description
description: Adds /pr-description: title, summary, diff totals and a test plan stub for the current branch against main or master, read with git. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: priority-bar
description: A band above the prompt with your open beads by priority (P0 2 · P1 14 · P2 60 · P3 50), red while a P0 is open, read with bd count every 2 minutes. Hidden without bd.

name: process-pane
description: A live side pane of the processes the session's Bash calls started that still run, with pid, age and command. Read-only: one ps every 5 seconds. Open it with /procs.

name: prod-db-guard
description: Asks before destructive SQL runs in a command: TRUNCATE, DELETE or UPDATE with no WHERE.

name: protect-main
description: Asks before a commit, push or merge while you are on main or master. Reads the branch with git.

name: publish-guard
description: Asks before a package is published: npm, pnpm, yarn or bun publish, cargo publish, twine upload, gem push, poetry or uv publish. Dry runs pass.

name: quality-pack
description: Three quiet nudges in one mod: type check after TypeScript edits, lockfile after dependency edits, and a split suggestion past 500 changed lines.

name: readme-check
description: Adds /readme-check: missing README sections (install, usage, licence, contributing) and broken relative links, at the git repo root. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: ready
description: Adds /ready: the 20 top ready beads, one line each, and the total. Read with bd, the beads tracker. Read-only. Prints only, copies nothing.

name: receipt
description: Adds /receipt: a shareable receipt of the session (tools, files, commands, blocks, context, cost), printed and copied.

name: recent
description: Adds /recent: your last 15 commits across all local branches (author is git user.name), with branch and date. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: registry-push-guard
description: Asks before an image or chart is pushed to a registry: docker push, docker buildx --push, podman push, helm push, gcloud artifacts docker push. Local registries pass.

name: release-pack
description: Asks before a release leaves your machine: package publish, tag push, production deploy and registry push guards in one mod. The tag guard reads tags with git.

name: render-pack
description: Both original rendering mods in one: diff-stats bars on Edit and Write rows, and file-links in Claude's replies (a click puts @path in the prompt).

name: render-plus
description: Three row badges in one: time-badge, exit-badge and size-badge.

name: reply-language
description: Answers in the language you set (English by default). Code, identifiers and commands stay as they are.

name: repo-pack
description: Five read-only repo commands in one mod: /todos, /loc, /hotspots, /commit-msg and /branches. They read git. They copy results to the clipboard.

name: reviewer-mode
description: After each code change, reviews its own diff like a strict senior reviewer and lists each issue it found and fixed.

name: rubber-duck
description: Restates the problem in its own words and lists its assumptions before it starts work.

name: say-done
description: On macOS, speaks "Claude is done" with the say command when a turn ends after more than 30 seconds. Does nothing on other platforms.

name: scripts
description: Adds /scripts: runnable tasks from package.json scripts, Makefile targets, justfile recipes and pyproject scripts at the git repo root. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: secret-commit-guard
description: Asks before a git commit that would record a credential or a secret-named file. Reads the staged diff with git.

name: secret-filename-guard
description: Asks before a Bash command touches a secret-looking file (.env, private keys, credentials).

name: secret-guard
description: Asks before a live API key, token or private key is written, edited or run.

name: secret-output-guard
description: Tells Claude not to repeat a credential that showed up in command or file output, and names the source to rotate.

name: secret-scan
description: Adds /secret-scan: tracked files and line numbers that hold secret-shaped text, found with git grep. Never prints a matched value. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: security-mode
description: Checks each change for injection, secrets, authorization and unsafe input, and states the risks it checked.

name: session-clock
description: A band above the prompt with the wall clock and how long the session has run (14:05 · 1h 12m).

name: session-journal
description: Appends one line per session end (time, directory, reason) to ~/.claude/journal.log.

name: sha-links
description: Commit SHAs in Claude's replies, and in the output of git commands, become links to the commit page when origin is on GitHub or GitLab. Display only.

name: shakespeare-mode
description: Prose in Early Modern English flair. Code, commands, commit messages and error text stay exact.

name: ship-safe-pack
description: The release-pack guards plus db-reset-guard and upload-guard: asks before publish, tag push, production deploy, registry push, database wipes and file uploads. Reads tags with git.

name: size
description: Adds /size: the 15 largest tracked files and the total tracked size at HEAD, read with git. Read-only. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: size-badge
description: Read and Write rows show how much was read or written: the line count, for example 312 lines, or the file size for images and PDFs.

name: slack-notify
description: Posts to a Slack incoming webhook when Claude Code needs your input. Sends the project name and a short status only. Does nothing until you set a webhook URL.

name: socratic-mode
description: For learning: answers a question with a short hint and one guiding question first, and gives the full answer when you ask. Code and commands stay exact.

name: sounds-arcade
description: Arcade blips: a coin when tests pass, a game-over drop when they fail, a buzz when a call is blocked, a power-up when a turn ends.

name: sounds-minimal
description: Very short, quiet clicks and ticks for a subtle signal: a tick when tests pass, two low ticks when they fail, a click when a call is blocked, a soft tick when a turn ends.

name: sounds-nature
description: Soft nature sounds: a bird chirp when tests pass, a plunk into water when they fail, a gust of wind when a call is blocked, a water drop when a turn ends.

name: sounds-office
description: Quiet office sounds: a soft click when tests pass, a low thud when they fail, paper when a call is blocked.

name: sounds-retro
description: 8-bit sounds: a coin when tests pass, a buzz when they fail, a chime when a turn ends.

name: sounds-scifi
description: Sci-fi console sounds: a beep when tests pass, an alarm when they fail, a warp when a turn ends.

name: sounds-zen
description: Soft bells and singing-bowl tones: a bell when tests pass, a low bowl when they fail, a muted chime when a call is blocked, a bowl when a turn ends.

name: sports-narrator
description: One line of sports play-by-play at turn end. OFF by default: one haiku call per turn with tools. Turn on the enabled option. Sends tool names, file names and the first two words of each command.

name: ssh-guard
description: Asks before a private key in .ssh is read, authorized_keys or the SSH config is changed, or ssh-keygen would overwrite a key. Public keys and ssh -i pass. Reads HOME with printenv.

name: standup
description: Adds /standup: Yesterday, Today and Blockers from your git log and this session's record, printed and copied.

name: stashes
description: Adds /stashes: git stashes with their age and the branch each was made on. Read-only, never applies or drops. Copies the result to your clipboard.

name: stats-pack
description: The three original stats mods in one: /wrapped (copied to your clipboard), streaks and achievements on one shared daily rollup.

name: ste-mode
description: Replies in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English: approved words, short sentences, one instruction each, active voice.

name: delivery-check
description: 手動核對三個交稿路徑；存在不代表內容合格。尚待 Claude Code 原生驗證的教學原始碼。

name: first-mod
description: Teaching example: count observed tool-call events and show the tally

name: first-mod
description: Counts Claude's tool calls, shows the count beside the spinner, and adds a /tally command

name: mya
description: MYA: a voice for Claude Code on Linux/X11. Tap Right Ctrl to talk, Right Ctrl + Space to translate, and MYA answers aloud, with a ringing phone when it is your turn.

name: retrovis-mod
description: Classic media-player visualizer above the prompt: a plasma field and equalizer bars driven by the session (prompts, tool calls, turns). Needs function hooks and an interactive terminal.

name: tmux-status
description: Shows Claude Code's state (working, waiting for you, done) as coloured glyphs on your tmux window tabs.

name: creek-spinner
description: 把 Claude Code 的转圈换成中文小词和一条往右淌的小溪

name: while-you-wait
description: While Claude works, the side panel lists what you can do meanwhile on GitHub: pull requests waiting for your review (with the diff and a quick pre-review), your own pull requests that need you, issues assigned to you.

name: aws-profile-complete
description: Complete AWS_PROFILE=<profile>

name: usage-bar
description: 常驻输入框上方的用量状态条：5h/7d 额度、token、缓存与会话花费

name: cache-timer
description: Colored countdown bar above the prompt until the prompt cache expires

name: autonomous-loop
description: A state-machine graph engine that drives a ticket through claim -> worktree -> coding -> evaluate -> review -> human approval, spawning and monitoring subagents at each step.

name: status-bar
description: Context window as a stacked bar above the prompt, one color per /context category, plus cost, rate limits and recent tool calls

name: tallyrail
description: A task band above the prompt that opens by itself: Claude plans multi-step work, ticks each task as it goes, and the band closes when everything is done. Three views: list, single line, focus.

name: status-line
description: One plain-language line above the prompt saying roughly where a long task is, written by a cheap fast model.

name: wheel-finder
description: Don't reinvent the wheel: finds existing GitHub projects, MCP servers, skills and plugins that fit the conversation and shows them in a small pager above the prompt.

name: maxlearn
description: Study companion: lessons and flashcards from your chats and interests, scheduled with FSRS or SM-2 spaced repetition

name: vitrin
description: Claude'un gönderdiği resim, video, PDF, ses ve web sayfalarını terminalden çıkmadan sağdaki panelde canlı bir sayfa olarak gösterir

name: model-hint
description: Shows the active model at the end of the prompt hint line

name: lds-ops-pane
description: A pane and a band above the prompt showing the lds session: root, publicity (PUBLIC in red), owned worktrees, and the latest journal chapter.

name: ale
description: /ale-board: a live task board for an Agentic Label Engineering (ALE) run above the prompt and in a docked pane. Reads `python3 -m ale status --json` and the run's label files; read-only, LLM-free. An experiment on Claude Code function…

name: usage-band
description: Band above the prompt showing 5-hour and weekly Claude plan usage as progress bars

name: lossless-compaction
description: Lossless context compaction for Claude Code: old tool output moves to local files and comes back unchanged by id, or by what it is about with a Jev key.

name: shell-guard
description: Windows shell guard: fixes backslash drive paths in Bash, blocks quote-eating node -e / heredoc patterns, and catches PowerShell/Bash syntax sent to the wrong shell

name: pill-copy
description: copy-band (yash-gadodia) restyled: a copy icon at the top-right of every block (code, table, list, quote); click to copy.

name: pill-steps
description: next-steps (hamzafer) restyled: next prompts as Claude-colored pills above the prompt. Press 1-3 in an empty prompt, 0 to dismiss.

name: prompt-coach
description: Buttons above the prompt box that ask what your draft is missing and refine it

name: done-chime
description: 長いターンが終わったときと、許可を待っているときに音とトーストで知らせる

name: push-gate
description: git push などを止め、人が承認ボタンを押した 1 回だけ通す

name: side-question
description: /btw で、作業を止めずに会話の続きとして脇道の質問をし、答えをペインに出す。答えは会話に残らない

name: usage-meter
description: ターンごとのトークン数とキャッシュの割合をステータス行に出し、セッション中の推移をペインにグラフで描く

name: fleet
description: Your claude agents list in a side pane, with optional cones columns

name: prompt-highlight-md
description: プロンプト入力欄のコードブロックと行頭のMarkdown記法に色を付ける（設計の参考: https://github.com/nogu66/md-prompt）

name: statusline
description: Claude Codeのステータスラインを入力欄の上の帯に描画する

name: glance
description: A reply style + line icons that make Claude's key points visible at a glance

name: context-band
description: A row above the prompt with the working directory, its git branch and the skill loaded since your last message.

name: intent-gate
description: Classifies each prompt's intent with Jev (question, plan, review, execute, ops) and blocks file edits and git writes on question, plan and review turns.

name: loop-breaker
description: Notices the same failure coming back (a Bash command failing the same way, or the same error pasted again) and tells Claude to stop patching and diagnose.

name: rules-injector
description: Puts your zstack standing rules (house, global, project) into every system prompt, so you stop repeating them. /rules lists, adds and forgets them.

name: stack-blast-radius
description: Holds terraform/pulumi apply and destroy, gcloud/aws deletes, kubectl delete/apply, docker system prune, rm -rf outside build dirs, and destructive SQL behind a Proceed/Cancel pane with a dry-run preview.

name: turn-done-alert
description: Toasts when a long turn finishes or Claude is waiting on you, and shows a 'working 3m · 14 tools' heartbeat during long turns.

name: usage-meter
description: Status line with context fill and rate-limit use: ctx 42% 84k/200k · 5h 63% · 7d 12%.

name: zstack-pane
description: /zstack-pane (or /zs) opens a live pane of the current zstack run: agents, tasks, recent blockers and questions, and a field to steer all agents.

name: brief-sidebar
description: Sidebar of the problem briefs' open questions, with a comment box under each that sends your note to the model; nudges the model to keep the brief up to date

name: agentctl-remote-control
description: Restarts this session's Remote Control bridge when agentctl asks after a live account swap, and reports the bridge's presence with /agentctl-rc.

name: ctxroute-wrap-up-sensor
description: ctxroute wrapUp (experimental): tells ctxroute how full the context window is after each turn

name: realms
description: Private Linux desktops for Claude: test GUI apps in a headless labwc realm or an Omarchy VM, and watch them live in a pane

name: auto-mode
description: Judge pending permission requests with Jev before the permission dialog

name: jev-lint
description: Audits code standards function by function with TypeSafe jev: at the end of a turn it checks the files changed in that turn and writes violations below that turn's answer. Rules live in rules.md.

name: basepaint
description: Live BasePaint canvas and activity feed while Claude works

name: context-bar
description: Five-hour usage window as a colored bar above the prompt, toggled with /context-bar

name: file-guard
description: Deny writes to protected files (.env/secrets/keys) and dangerous Bash patterns, with a toast explaining why

name: mission-control
description: Mission control: session/turn tool-call counters in a Pane, an AbovePrompt band and a status entry

name: loadout
description: One theme picks the whole kit: terminal colours and background, the Avatar pane, the Flow map and the frames around conversation rows. /loadout switches it.

name: prompt-rewrite
description: /rewrite: turns a rough draft prompt into a thorough one, asking clarifying questions first, without adding anything to the conversation

name: agent-tasks
description: One pane for the session's subagents and Claude's own task list

name: music-mod
description: /music: what macOS Music.app is playing, in one line above the prompt. A pressable play/pause glyph, track · artist · album, a progress bar with the clocks, and a pressable next-track glyph. One read of Music.app every five seconds…

name: today-mod
description: /today: the day's agenda for Claude and for you. Calendar events, E3 deadlines and Reminders are read through the macos and nycu plugin scripts, shown as one line above the prompt with a countdown to the next event, and handed to Claude…
